text: In California, people on parole can vote.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Voting Rights Restored
truthSource.oneLine: Since Prop 17 (2020), Californians on parole or probation can register and vote. Only people currently serving a state or federal prison term for a felony cannot.

lesson.tip: This rule changed in 2020, but older explainers and screenshots still circulate. Check the date on anything about who can vote, and confirm against the current official page.
